# Assessment Overview

This index links to supplementary assessment artifacts generated for this report.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - Two-layer application and component architecture diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - External dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - API surface, communication patterns, and sequence contracts.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, entity relationships, and data boundaries.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, properties, runtime profiles, and secrets handling.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Primary domain workflows, decisions, and cross-service flow.
